entities.summary: Eeli Tolvanen is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a right winger for the Seattle Kraken of the National Hockey League (NHL). Tolvanen was selected by the Nashville Predators 30th overall, in the 2017 NHL entry draft. He was born and grew up in Vihti, Finland.
